theme_and_archetype.rationale: The user requested a light background redesign moving away from the dark luxury theme, drawing inspiration from Uber/Grab. A clean, high-contrast light theme maximizes legibility under Caribbean sunlight, removes clinical dark mode friction, and is proven to drive trust and conversions in multi-service marketplaces.

migration_blueprint.instructions: Replace the existing CSS variables in the root scope with the selected palette option. Preserve the component structure but update the Tailwind utility tokens. Remove neon effects and metallic gold gradients, replacing them with solid high-contrast backgrounds or soft glassmorphism for a modern, airy marketplace feel.

palette_options.rationale: High contrast, ultra-clean aesthetic proven to drive conversions in leading ride-hailing apps. Focuses entirely on usability and clear visual hierarchy, removing any distraction from the service categories.

typography.pairing_rationale: Outfit brings a modern, geometric tech feel, while IBM Plex Sans ensures high readability for complex data (like driver dashboards, currency conversion and menus).

styling.buttons: Square or slightly rounded (rounded-md), solid primary color, no gradient.
styling.cards: Flat background with 1px border (#E2E8F0), no shadow for default state. Subtle shadow on hover.
styling.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for active elements only.

palette_options.rationale: Maintains the island identity while transitioning to a light theme. Uses warm, sandy whites and energetic accents (sunset orange, ocean blue) to stimulate appetite for food delivery and excitement for car rentals.

typography.pairing_rationale: Manrope is highly readable but with friendly geometric curves that match an approachable, high-energy Caribbean brand.

styling.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for high energy and approachability.
styling.cards: Soft rounded corners (rounded-2xl) with subtle warm drop shadows.
styling.shadows: Soft and diffuse, tinted with a warm orange/brown hue (e.g., shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(249,115,22,0.1)]).

palette_options.rationale: A natural, healthy vibe utilizing deep tropical greens. Highly effective for grocery and pharmacy logistics, projecting reliability, health, and growth.

typography.pairing_rationale: Cabinet Grotesk provides strong, modern business authority, while Satoshi is highly legible and clean for quick-scan mobile interfaces.

styling.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-lg) with high-contrast active states.
styling.cards: Clean surfaces with a subtle 1px border and soft shadow on hover.
styling.shadows: Crisp and minimal, tinted with green (e.g., shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(6,78,59,0.08)]).

design_system_rules.spacing_and_layout: Use generous padding. Cards should use p-6 or p-8. Grid systems must be direct children. Utilize 'Bento' grids for service selection menus (Mode A) and strict 'Control Room' grids (Mode B) for dense driver/merchant dashboards.
design_system_rules.accessibility_and_contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text. Avoid pure black/white, use tinted neutrals. Always explicitly set hover text colors (e.g., hover:text-white).
design_system_rules.motion: Use Framer Motion for smooth transitions. Cards should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) on hover with a slight darkening of the border.
design_system_rules.surface_strategies: For headers, use Glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5). For dashboards, use flat solid surfaces with 1px border. Avoid muddy gray transparencies.
design_system_rules.components: Use Shadcn UI for structural interactive elements. Heavily customize border radii and colors to match the chosen palette. ADD data-testid attribute to all interactive elements.
